Council approves the river trail extension

Posted on October 18, 2026 by Dana Reyes

Town council voted six to one on Tuesday night to extend the river trail by four kilometres along the north bank, linking the boat launch at Mill Road with the new housing on the east side of town.

The paved path will be three metres wide and lit along its whole length. Construction starts in the spring and is expected to take two seasons, with the section between Mill Road and the rail bridge opening first.

Most of the cost is covered by a provincial active transportation grant. The town's share comes from the parks reserve, so no tax increase is needed, staff told council.

The one councillor who voted against the plan said she supports the trail but wanted the lighting budget spent on the existing path first. Residents can comment on the final design at an open house next month at the community centre.
